# Domain

<!-- What is true about the problem space that the code cannot tell you. Vocabulary
     with precise meanings, domain truths, platform facts, and the assumptions the
     design rests on. Under 150 lines. -->

## Vocabulary

<!-- One line each. Only terms with a precise, project-specific meaning. -->

- **<term>** — <meaning>. Source: <doc or decision>.

## Domain truths

<!-- Facts about the world that a design must not violate. Each with its evidence. -->

- <Fact.> Evidence: <incident, measurement, spec, platform doc>.

## Platform facts

<!-- Behaviors of the OS, runtime, or substrate that shaped decisions. -->

- <Fact.> Consequence: <what we do because of it>. Source: <decision id>.

## Assumptions

<!-- Only assumptions something depends on. Each says what breaks if it is false. -->

- <Assumption.> If false: <which decisions or invariants must be revisited>.
